positive_terms: Disclosure of whether and how understanding of people in its own workforce with particular characteristics, working in particular contexts, or undertaking particular activities may be at greater risk of harm has been developed
特定特征或情境员工更高风险的理解
说明主体是否以及如何形成对特定特征、特定情境或特定活动员工可能面临更高伤害风险的理解。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
